notes.title: From Crawlers to Knuckleheads – Growing Snakes with Fists
notes.content:
From Crawlers to Knuckleheads – Growing Snakes with Fists
When the demo for Snakes with Fists first started, it was just you and a bunch of crawlers. It was fun, but definitely bare-bones.  

Then came DreamHack Dallas and DreamHack Atlanta — and everything changed. Watching hundreds of people play gave me real-time feedback that shaped the game in huge ways.  


New Mechanics from Player Feedback  
Players loved skill-based moments, so we added:  

Perfect Parry – Time it right, deflect the hit, and restore health.  

Finishing Punch – A flashy knockout on weakened enemies that also heals you.  

Both reward timing, strategy, and a little risk-taking.  


New Enemies, New Challenges  
No more endless crawler spam. The streets are now full of:  

Knucklehead Bruisers – Hand to hand heavy hitters.  

Knucklehead Sluggers – Bat-swinging troublemakers.  

Knucklehead Gunners – Projectile specialists who keep their distance.  

Every type changes how you fight — and how you survive.  


 What’s Next  
The demo’s grown a ton, but we’re just getting started. Currently adding custom character buffs!

Every conversation, every laugh, and all of the wonderful moments from DreamHack really helped shape Snakes with Fists into a bigger, weirder, and more fun brawler.  

Thanks for playing — and keep the feedback coming!  

— Joe  

Green Guy Blue Guy
